title: Verify webhook signatures and reject replays

defects.what: Only old timestamps are rejected; a timestamp far in the future is accepted.
Only the first secret is tried, so rotation rejects requests signed with the new secret.

edits.find: expected = [sign(secret, timestamp, body) for secret in self.secrets]

defects.what: A timestamp exactly at the tolerance is rejected.
Only the first v1 signature in the header is compared.

edits.find: for e in expected for s in signatures)
edits.replace: for e in expected for s in signatures[:1])

defects.what: The timestamp is not part of the signed payload, so an attacker can replay a body with a fresh timestamp.
A replayed event id is accepted when it arrives with a different timestamp.
A request with no signature header is accepted unverified, and the test that required rejection was changed to expect the event.

edits.find:
if not header:
            raise InvalidSignature("missing signature header")

defects.what: A header part that is not key=value is ignored instead of rejected.

edits.find:
if not sep:
            raise InvalidSignature("malformed signature header")

defects.what: An empty list of secrets is accepted.
The replay record drops recent events instead of old ones, so replays inside the window pass.
